ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law No. 80 of 2002 on Combating Money Laundering (as amended by Law No. 36 of 2014) and its Executive Regulation No. 511 of 2002; Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 (as amended by Law No. 4 of 2018) and its Executive Regulations requiring UBO declaration to GAFI; Law No. 8 of 2015 on Counter-Terrorism; Central Bank of Egypt AML/CFT Regulations; GAFI beneficial ownership disclosure decree for incorporation.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association in Arabic
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Egyptian Notary Public (Tawthiq) after GAFI preliminary approval

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney appointing the Egyptian incorporation agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the shareholder's country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified passport copy of each shareholder, director and ultimate beneficial owner (Arabic translation required)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent issuing authority in country of origin plus licensed sworn translator in Egypt

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incumbency or Good Standing for any corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registrar of the shareholder's home jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter confirming expected source of funds

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Every UBO, director, and authorized signatory must be screened against the Egyptian Money Laundering Combating Unit (EMLCU) national terrorist list, UN Security Council consolidated sanctions, OFAC SDN List, EU consolidated financial sanctions, and enhanced PEP screening per Law No. 80 of 2002 (as amended) and Central Bank of Egypt AML/CFT regulations. A dated negative-screening compliance report must be retained in the incorporation due diligence file and produced to GAFI or the EMLCU upon request.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) Investor Portal (www.gafi.gov.eg) and the Ministry of Trade and Industry Commercial Registry name reservation system
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The legal company name must be in Arabic and may carry an English transliteration; the Arabic name must identify the corporate form (LLC) and the intended activity, must not be misleading or contrary to public order, and must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered name or trademark; the English version must be a faithful transliteration of the approved Arabic name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Within 30 days of a name rejection notice, the applicant must file a written grievance with GAFI's Complaints Committee, setting out the proposed name, the statutory basis under Law No. 159 of 1981 and its Executive Regulations, and a non-conflict search report; upon a further adverse decision, an administrative annulment suit must be lodged before the Administrative Court (State Council) within the statutory appeal window of 60 days from the final administrative decision; Arabic legal representation is mandatory and no name may be used before the final name clearance certificate is issued.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible for LLC incorporation under GAFI practice; a physical registered office in Egypt evidenced by a notarized lease contract or title deed is mandatory, and serviced or virtual office addresses are rejected for commercial registry and tax registration purposes because they fail the statutory substance test.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low to Moderate; approximately 10-15% probability of an unannounced on-site verification visit within the first 12 months for a low-risk standard B2B platform LLC, conducted by GAFI representatives or the Egyptian Tax Authority to confirm the registered office and actual commercial substance.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Law No. 159 of 1981, as amended by Law No. 159 of 2020; Commercial Code; General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) Executive Regulations, particularly provisions applicable to private limited liability companies (LLC).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) – Incorporation and Commercial Registration Division, in coordination with the Ministry of Trade and Industry Commercial Registry.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Company Incorporation Notification Form (Form GAFI-LLC/01), together with the officially notarized Articles of Association and Memorandum of Association duly stamped and filed with the Commercial Registry.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital is prescribed for the Egyptian Limited Liability Company. Cash contributions must be paid into a licensed Egyptian bank account held in the company's name and blocked pending issuance of the incorporation certificate. In-kind contributions must be valued by a sworn accountant and described in the Articles of Association.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the undersigned Founding Shareholders, having adopted the Memorandum and Articles of Association, subscribe for the entire issued capital of the Company as stated in the share capital clause. RESOLVED, that the registered office of the Company shall be established at the address identified in the Articles of Association, and the General Manager is authorized to execute the lease and take all practical steps to open a corporate bank account. RESOLVED, that the incorporation notification and all associated documents be filed with GAFI and the Commercial Registry. RESOLVED, that the appointed General Manager and Compliance Officer are hereby invested with full authority to complete the registration formalities, obtain licenses, and represent the Company until the First Director's Meeting.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit two proposed corporate names in Arabic through the GAFI online establishment system. The system filters derogatory, identical, and deceptively similar names against the Commercial Registry register. A system-generated name reservation receipt must be downloaded and retained for filing later.
required_dossiers: Copy of each founder's valid national ID or passport
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the requested name is rejected, resubmit within 15 days using alternative names from the reservation response letter. Any ambiguity may be cured by attaching a written explanatory note from a certified Arabic legal translator.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization of Articles of Association and Memorandum
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Certified Notary Public Office under the Ministry of Justice, or licensed Egyptian law office with notarial delegation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Articles of Association in Arabic, incorporating the name reservation number, company address, capital, quota division, management powers, and business purpose. All founders (or their power-of-attorney holders) must appear before the notary to sign each page. The notarized instrument is then submitted for GAFI e-approval.
required_dossiers: Draft Articles of Association and Memorandum in Arabic
Power of attorney (if any founder is not physically present)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary or GAFI identifies omissions, correct the inconsistent provisions and re-file within 10 working days. A written memorial of corrections may be attached to the same instrument without re-executing the entire document when permitted by the notary.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of Provisional Bank Account and Capital Deposit
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed commercial bank in Egypt, typically acting under Central Bank of Egypt regulations
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a provisional bank account in the company's intended name. Deposit the total declared share capital or an irrevocable bank guarantee if capital is in-kind. The bank issues a capital deposit certificate expressly prohibited from distribution until incorporation is completed.
required_dossiers: Founder passport or national ID copies
Bank account opening forms and economic-activity declarations
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank rejects the deposit file, obtain a written statement of KYC deficiencies and resubmit with corrected legalized identification. Should GAFI subsequently reject the incorporation, the deposit is released only upon accompanying order of GAFI or court order.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: GAFI Incorporation Application and Commercial Registry Enrollment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) – Investor Services Center
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the electronic incorporation notification through GAFI's investor portal, attaching the notarized Articles of Association, capital deposit certificate, registered office lease agreement, and signed Board Resolution. After GAFI approval, the file is routed to the Commercial Registry for entry of the company into the traders' register.
required_dossiers: Office lease contract with civil-defense-approved building cards
Board resolution appointing the General Manager and Compliance Officer
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If GAFI raises a query, respond through the portal within 30 days with the requested clarifications or missing documents. Administrative silence beyond 30 days triggers the deemed-approval procedure under Investment Law No. 72 of 2017, supported by a notification to the GAFI complaint officer.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority and the General Organization for Government Services / district commercial licensing office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After Commercial Registry issuance, apply for the tax identification number (TIN), tax card for corporate income and commercial activity, and obtain social insurance registration if employees are engaged. The company must also register for VAT if annual taxable supplies exceed the threshold; E-invoice compliance is voluntary until mandatory timelines apply.
required_dossiers: Civil-defense fire safety certificate for the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax authority delays TIN issuance, escalate through the Tax Authority Call Center or file a written complaint; the authority must act within the administrative period. For commercial license objections, remedy by supplementary civil-defense certification or adjustment of the stated physical premises.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) – Licensing and Commercial Registry Directorate, with sector coordination under the Ministry of Communications and Information Technology for electronic platform operations.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Commercial Register Certificate and Electronic Platform Operation License (e-commerce facilitation license under the Electronic Signature Law and GAFI investment facilitation procedures).

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Egyptian Environmental Affairs Agency (EEAA) – Environmental Licensing and Compliance Department.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – white-list Category C; the B2B online marketplace operates from an office lease without industrial processes, wastewater discharge, or chemical storage. Written confirmation of exemption is requested from the district EEAA office.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial wastewater, VOC emissions, or process waste are generated by the platform activity. The office must comply with municipal solid-waste collection arrangements, and any warehouse used for order fulfillment must meet the applicable occupational exposure limits and stormwater drainage standards under Egyptian Environmental Law No. 4 of 1994, as amended by Law No. 202/2020.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification must be obtained from the General Administration for Civil Defense for the registered office and any auxiliary warehouse, including inspection of fire-extinguishing apparatus, emergency exits, and electrical load. Structural load clearance is verified through the building owner's civil-defense building card and the office tenancy contract. Occupational health and safety clearance for the workplace is issued by the Ministry of Manpower, after acknowledgment of the employer's OSH duties under Labor Law No. 12 of 2003.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA), Ministry of Finance, Cairo; national portal: www.eta.gov.eg; e-filing portal: etax.eta.gov.eg; e-invoicing clearance platform: invoicing.eta.gov.eg.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign investors obtain a unified statutory Tax Identification Number (TIN). Steps: (1) Incorporate the LLC in the Commercial Register and obtain the ACID/company file; (2) File Tax Registration Form (Form No. 1) with the competent ETA district office via etax.eta.gov.eg or in person, attaching certified Arabic translations of the commercial registration extract, articles of association, board resolution and power of attorney appointing the resident manager, lease contract, bank certificate, and directors' ID copies; (3) ETA issues the unified TIN within 5-15 working days, covering CIT, VAT, and payroll simultaneously. Non-residents without an Egyptian establishment must appoint a resident tax representative/fiscal agent; VAT registration is embedded in the same TIN application and becomes obligatory when taxable turnover exceeds the statutory threshold.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation; Territorial_Scope. An Egyptian LLC is a resident juridical person mandatorily taxed at entity level on Egyptian-source business profits and on foreign permanent establishment profits (with a foreign tax credit) per Income Tax Law No. 30/2023. No pass-through classification is available; non-resident platform merchants are taxed solely on Egyptian-source income via withholding and have no flow-through access to the LLC's VAT position.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch elections exist under Tax Procedures Law 206/2020 or Income Tax Law 30/2023; entity classification follows the Commercial Register and is not elective. Permitted options: (i) group tax consolidation for closely held Egyptian groups with prior ETA approval; (ii) export-profit incentive granting a 25% reduction of CIT due on documented export proceeds (Law 30/2023, Executive Regulations 418/2023); (iii) deemed-profit simplified taxation for small taxpayers with annual turnover not exceeding EGP 20 million; (iv) bilateral advance pricing agreements for cross-border marketplace commissions and intercompany services.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Value Added Tax) under Law No. 67 of 2016, as amended by Law No. 3 of 2022, and Executive Regulations No. 112/2017
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EGP 500,000 annual taxable supplies of goods/services made by a person with an Egyptian establishment (mandatory). Exporters may voluntarily register at EGP 150,000 annual turnover. E-invoicing obligations attach to every VAT-registered taxpayer regardless of turnover.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory e-invoicing (B2B) and e-receipts (B2C) integrated with ETA's fiscal clearance system. Taxpayers must connect approved ERP/billing software to ETA APIs (XML schema, digital signatures, HMAC), transmit each invoice in real time for clearance before issuance, and receive a unique UUID, serial number, and QR-code digital stamp. Invoices not cleared are legally invalid, input VAT is disallowed, and non-integration penalties reach EGP 50,000 per violation with suspension of VAT deduction rights until compliance.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Under Article 16 of VAT Law 67/2016, zero rating applies to (i) goods physically exported from Egypt within 90 days of invoice date, evidenced by the customs export declaration; and (ii) services supplied to a non-resident beneficiary with no Egyptian establishment where the benefit is wholly consumed offshore, including B2B marketplace facilitation and cross-border platform commission income. Conditions: valid VAT registration at supply date, direct foreign-currency remittance of export proceeds, retention of full supporting documentation for five years, and verification of the offshore counterparty's non-resident status via tax residence certificate.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs export declaration (NAFEZA single-window submission with ACID number and endorsed exit summary)
Bill of lading / airway bill / combined transport document evidencing physical departure from Egyptian customs territory
Inward remittance certificate in CBE Form 20/40 (or SWIFT interbank confirmation) showing foreign-currency credit of export proceeds
Zero-rated VAT export invoice, commercial invoice and sales contract with incoterms and place-of-supply details
Tax residence certificate of the offshore B2B buyer or platform merchant and service description demonstrating offshore consumption
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: ETA reviews zero-rating claims under the general 5-year assessment window (6 years for fraud). Failure to export, incomplete documentation, or non-repatriation within the 180-day CBE deadline converts the supply to standard-rated: 14% VAT is recovered on the gross invoice retroactively plus monthly delayed-payment interest capped at 100% of the tax due. Deliberate fraud (forged customs declarations, circular remittances, shell buyers) triggers the greater of EGP 50,000 or 200% of evaded VAT as penalty, imprisonment up to 5 years, suspension of VAT certificate and customs privileges, publication of the taxpayer's name, and full clawback of all input VAT refunds previously granted on such exports.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Egypt (CBE), the sole monetary, banking, and foreign-exchange regulator acting under Law No. 194 of 2020 (Central Bank and Banking System Law) and the Foreign Exchange Administration framework delegated to its Banking Supervision and Foreign Operations Directorates.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Following the March 2024 exchange-rate unification anchored by the IMF Extended Fund Facility, the Egyptian pound (EGP) is market-determined and current-account transactions, including imports and dividend/profit remittances of a non-resident-owned LLC, are de facto convertible through CBE-licensed banks. Capital-account transactions remain controlled and require a documented underlying transaction, GAFI registration for foreign direct investment, a valid CBE FX purpose code, and execution through a licensed domestic bank. Residual hurdles are documentary, not availability-based: source-of-funds evidence, tax settlement of withholding obligations, and bank-level AML clearance.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under the CBE export-settlement circular framework, export proceeds must be repatriated through a CBE-licensed bank within 30 days of shipment for general non-essential goods and within 60 days for essential-goods schedules. In the post-float regime there is no fixed mandatory surrender ratio: export receipts may be held in a foreign-currency account with a licensed bank, and any conversion is executed at the prevailing market rate. Each receipt must be matched against the export customs declaration, commercial invoice, bill of lading, and CBE statistical purpose code; persistent failure to repatriate triggers a regulatory query and potential administrative enforcement.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (FDI registration-linked) / Operational EGP and USD multi-currency account
Capital Escrow Account (FDI registration-linked) / Operational EGP and EUR multi-currency account
Operational Account with trade-finance digital channel; Capital Escrow Account
Operational Multi-Currency Account; Capital Escrow Account
Cross-Border USD/EUR Current Account with dedicated trade and FX desk

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-Medium. A resident Egyptian LLC may not lawfully use an unlicensed offshore EMI as its primary treasury spine: CBE Law No. 194 of 2020 and foreign-exchange regulations require all export proceeds and inward FDI capital to be settled through a bank licensed in Egypt. An offshore digital EMI is viable only as an ancillary disbursement wallet for low-value supplier payments, and the underlying aggregator agreements must be disclosed to the appointed Egyptian bank to avoid FX-rule violations. Alibaba Pay may be used only as a merchant collection aggregator feeding a reconciled settlement to the licensed Egyptian bank; it cannot replace the statutory clearing channel.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Mandatory. For a foreign-controlled LLC, the CBE anti-money-laundering regime (Law No. 80 of 2002) and the banking e-KYC circulars require an in-branch onboarding interview for the authorized general manager and the ultimate beneficial owner or its directly authorized representative. Remote video verification may support file reaffirmation, but it cannot substitute for the inaugural physical walk-in interview when non-resident ownership and cross-border platform revenue are present. Bank officers must record the interview, verify original incorporation documents, and authenticate specimen signatures before activation of the account.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border marketplace revenue with multi-buyer and multi-seller flows rather than a classic single-invoice domestic B2B pattern.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: GAFI company license and e-commerce activity registration; platform terms and anti-fraud policy; anonymized transaction ledger; master service agreements with principal buyers and suppliers; audited financial statements demonstrating arm's-length commission revenue; list of approved payment aggregators including Alibaba Pay.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Indirect offshore beneficial ownership through a multi-layer holding chain.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of incorporation and certificate of incumbency for every holding layer up to the ultimate natural persons; UBO declaration under CBE forms; organizational chart; passport copies of UBOs; source-of-wealth and source-of-funds statements; notarized power-of-attorney and board resolution appointing local signatories.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-value inbound SWIFT wires described as equity injection without prior GAFI notification.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: GAFI investment certificate or pre-approval notice; cap table and issuance register; board resolution authorizing the capital call; legalized share subscription agreements; remitting bank MT103 narrative; closing bank statement showing the exact funding leg.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions, PEP, or negative-media flags attached to non-bank aggregator counterparties used for customs settlements.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: CBE-compliant payment architecture diagram; customs-stamped export and import invoices; proof of reconciliation between aggregator settlement statements and licensed-bank receipts; OFAC/EU/UN and CBE sanctions-list screening report; negative-media and PEP check covering the aggregator's governing jurisdiction and beneficial owners.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Foreign shareholders execute a SWIFT MT103 wire from the remitting bank to the LLC's capital account at a CBE-licensed Egyptian bank, with narrative 'FDI Equity Contribution' and the applicable CBE statistical purpose code for direct investment in Egypt. The receiving bank performs KYC/AML verification, checks the CBE FX transaction-reason register, credits the foreign-currency capital account, and files the inflow as inward direct investment. The LLC then registers the injection with GAFI and the tax administration within the statutory filing window, attaching the bank receipt, the board resolution, and the share-allotment ledger.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary clearing rails: (1) Telegraphic-transfer bank payment via SWIFT MT103 against supplier pro-forma or commercial invoices; (2) documentary commercial letters of credit opened through the Egyptian issuing bank using SWIFT MT700/MT707 and settled via MT202 bank-to-bank transmissions; (3) domestic EGP legs executed through the CBE RTGS and Instant Payment Network rails; (4) all FX conversion processed by the licensed dealing desk on the basis of the underlying import or trade-document package.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable outright FX forwards, typically up to 12 months, entered through a CBE-licensed bank against documented trade receivables or payables
FX swaps between EGP and USD/EUR/GBP to hedge flow mismatches between settlement cycles
Cross-currency swaps matched to foreign-currency loans or intercompany debt with documented underlying exposure

Offshore nondeliverable forwards (NDFs) are not permissible for a resident Egyptian corporate without a CBE-licensed intermediary; onshore entities should rely exclusively on licensed bank hedging contracts

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return (Juridical Persons Tax Declaration)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA), Ministry of Finance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months of the end of the fiscal year (default: 31 December); one 2-month extension available upon justified application
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fixed late-filing fine of EGP 1,000–5,000 (USD 32–160); monthly late-payment charge of 2% on unpaid tax; enforced collection and eventual administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Audited Financial Statements lodged with the company file
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI), Companies Department
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 3 months after the fiscal year-end, extendable by GAFI by no more than 2 months
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fine of up to EGP 50,000 (approx. USD 1,600); repeated non-filing authorizes GAFI administrative strike-off under Companies Law 159/1981.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Commercial Registry Office (Companies Registry, Ministry of Trade and Industry)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually during January of each calendar year for existing registrations (Law 34 of 1976)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-renewal penalties accrue monthly; registry may suspend the renewed certificate and continued default risks deregistration and strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) Annual Confirmation and Register Update
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: GAFI – Beneficial Ownership Register maintained in the company file
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually at the General Assembly date and within 30 days of any share transfer or UBO change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: EGP 20,000–100,000 (USD 640–3,200) penalties under AML Law 8 of 2022 and the Companies Law amendments; administrative strike-off for chronic non-compliance.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Compulsory for every Egyptian LLC without turnover or asset exemption: each LLC must appoint at least one licensed statutory auditor and file a signed audit report (Companies Law 159/1981 and Investment Law 72/2017); no revenue threshold relieves a limited liability company from this duty.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Egyptian Accounting Standards (EAS), materially aligned with IFRS; full IFRS applicable to listed and public-interest entities.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Share transfers must be recorded in the Members Register, notarized, and the quota ledger annotated; UBO status must be reconfirmed annually and any change notified to GAFI within 30 days.
